personality_one_liner: A visual-first, colorful, and highly approachable home management hub that makes tracking property details feel rewarding rather than like a chore.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for large touch targets. Use safe-area for header and tab bar.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar
Use glass on the Add action sheet background overlay
Use glass for sticky date headers in the calendar view
dont's: Avoid glass on the primary colorful tiles
Do not use glass for form inputs or standard list rows

screens.name: Home Hub
screens.purpose: A visual-first dashboard replacing 'My Home', giving a scannable summary of upcoming bills and quick access to 6 core property modules.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for the 6 tiles and top reminder strip.
states.empty: A friendly empty state inside the next-3-due strip: 'Everything is up to date! Enjoy your day.'
states.error: Failed to load home data. [Retry] button.

screens.layout:
1. Header: 'Home Switcher' (e.g., '123 Main St ▼' in DM Serif Display). 
2. Monthly Total: A bold stat block showing this month's expenses. 
3. Next 3 Due Strip: A horizontal scroll of 3 compact cards. Left border color-coded by status (Red=Overdue, Yellow=Due Soon, Green=Paid). 
4. 6 Big Tiles Grid: 2 columns. Massive touch targets. Each tile has a tinted background, a thick-stroke Ionicon, and bold label. Bills (Orange), Records (Indigo), Items (Teal), Repairs (Red), Saved (Gold), Calendar (Green). 
5. Floating Action Button (FAB): A prominent oversized '+' anchored at bottom right, opening the Add Sheet.

screens.name: Add Sheet (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: A 4-option unified add menu (Bill, Record, Item, Repair) keeping addition within 3 taps.
screens.layout: BottomSheet with 4 large list rows or a 2x2 grid of huge tap targets. Tapping one instantly transitions to a simplified form.

screens.name: Add Bill Form
screens.purpose: Quick entry form designed to hit the '3 taps to add' metric.
screens.layout: Large numeric input for amount. Horizontal scrolling chips for Schedule (Once, Weekly, Monthly) and Reminders (3 days before). Big sticky 'Save' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Bills & Reminders
screens.purpose: List of all bills, categorized by status, with quick-pay actions.

states.empty: Icon: `receipt-outline`. Text: 'No upcoming bills. You're all caught up!'

screens.layout: Segmented Control (Upcoming, Paid). ListRows with left icon, title, amount, and due date. Swiping or tapping a 'Mark Paid' checkbox triggers a micro-celebration animation.

screens.name: Records
screens.purpose: Digital filing cabinet for home documents.

states.empty: Icon: `folder-open-outline`. Text: 'Your digital filing cabinet is empty. Add receipts or warranties here.'

screens.layout: Folder-style navigation. 2-column grid of folders (Receipts, Agreements, Property docs, Warranties, Utility bills, Other). Inside: list of uploaded files.

screens.name: Items
screens.purpose: Visual inventory of household items with values.

states.empty: Icon: `sofa-outline` (Note: fallback to `bed-outline` if unavailable). Text: 'What's in your home? Snap a photo to add your first item.'

screens.layout: Masonry or 2-column grid of image cards. Each card has a photo cover, item name, and value/warranty tag.

screens.name: Repairs
screens.purpose: Track maintenance and directly book FIXA pros.

states.empty: Icon: `hammer-outline`. Text: 'Everything is running smoothly. Log a repair when needed.'

screens.layout: List of upcoming maintenance. Each row includes a 'Book a FIXA pro' secondary CTA button and a shortcut to 'Improve My Property'.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Month view showing bills, maintenance, and expiries.

states.empty: N/A (Calendar always shows days, empty agenda below it).

screens.layout: Top half: Month view grid with colored dots (Red=Overdue, Yellow=Due Soon, Green=Paid). Bottom half: Agenda list for the selected day.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Amass token palette mapping: Bills (marketOrange #F97316), Records (info/premium indigo #4F46E5), Items (declutterTeal #14B8A6), Repairs (brand red #E11B22), Saved (massGold #D4AF37), Calendar (success green #2E8B57).
Status colors for the Next 3 Due strip MUST be mapped to: Overdue = brand red (#E11B22), Due Soon = warning yellow (#C99E0E), Paid = success green (#2E8B57).
Typography: Use DM Serif Display for headings, the 'Home Switcher', and the Monthly Total. Use Plus Jakarta Sans (max weight 500) for all other UI text.

Implement the large 6-tile grid using `width: '48%'` wrapped in a row with `justifyContent: 'space-between'` and generous gap. Ensure the icons (Ionicons) are large, with thick strokes, and use outline variants (e.g., `receipt-outline`, `folder-outline`, `bed-outline`, `hammer-outline`, `heart-outline`, `calendar-outline`).
Add a prominent floating action button (FAB) at the bottom right of the Home Hub that opens a BottomSheet to select Bill, Record, Item, or Repair.
The 'Add Bill' flow MUST be fully optimized for speed (3 taps). Use horizontal scrolling chips for 'Schedule' and 'Reminders'.
Implement a micro-animation (e.g., Lottie confetti or a Reanimated checkmark pop) when a user taps 'Mark Paid' on a bill.
Ensure 'Book a FIXA pro' is visible as a secondary CTA button on every repair list item.
Provide high-contrast, friendly empty states with the specific copy provided in the screen specs.
